dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing from a wide mid-body section toward a pointed posterior peduncle region.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth, symmetrical lateral margins with no significant deviations or bulges visible.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse lighter patches and a prominent longitudinal light-pigmented streak along the central dorsal line.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the primary slate-grey skin and lighter pigmented markings.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A sharp, elongated vertical light-pigmented mark is visible along the dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single prominent vertical linear mark along the central dorsal axis.
other_distinctive_markers: Clearly defined circular blowhole at the anterior apex.
